Originating from nomad weaponsmiths, this straightforward bow design incorporates laser projectors and internal gyroscopes to ensure the first arrow loosed is always on target. Most commonly seen in the hands of nomad scouts that need to remain swift, silent, and able to change munitions on the fly for when a mission unexpectedly goes awry.

Cost: 400eb (Expensive)

Class: Bow • Skill: Archery • Range: Shortbow

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: NoSlots: 1 • Attachments: Laser Sight, Zenith • Mods: None

Special Features: The Laser Sight can be activated or deactivated as an Action. While it is active and wielding this weapon in two hands, it functions as Excellent Quality but incurs a -2 penalty to Stealth Checks, or a -4 against characters utilizing Infrared/Nightvision [Laser Sight]. The first Turn in combat this weapon makes a Single Shot Attack, the user gains a +1 bonus to their Attack Check [Zenith].

Range: Shortbow
Pre-installed: Laser Sight, Zenith (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
